content: shadcn/ui's 'form' registry item (new-york-v4/ui/form.tsx) still exports the classic Form=FormProvider, FormField (wraps react-hook-form Controller), FormItem, FormLabel, FormControl, FormDescription, FormMessage API as of 2026-09-28 — confirmed by fetching the live registry JSON at ui.shadcn.com/r/styles/new-york-v4/form.json. A parallel newer 'Field'-based primitive (Field/FieldLabel/FieldError) also exists in shadcn's docs but is a separate, additive pattern, not a replacement — 'npx shadcn add form' still installs the classic API this project's UI-SPEC already specifies.
